brief_summary: Two side-by-side lineage cards contrasting Mode's two mounting systems: the warm-grey Mounting Block System (Sonnet, EPU41 polymer blocks over plate tabs, in catalog since 2024) and the coral Crown Mounting System (debuted on Prologue 2026-09-17 at 98% preorders from $349, now reported by PC Gamer as headed to a refreshed Encore). A dashed connector between the cards is labeled 'not the same system' to flag that this is not one lineage upgraded but two distinct systems on two different boards.
data_sources: mode-lull-breaks-crown-mounting-encore.mdx § Callout 'Two mounting systems, not one upgraded' — 'Mode now has two distinct mounting technologies in its catalog: the Mounting Block System, which has shipped on Sonnet since 2024, and the Crown Mounting System, which is newer and debuted on Prologue in September 2026.'

mode-lull-breaks-crown-mounting-encore.mdx § 'The feature isn't new — it's just new to Encore' — 'Mode calls the Mounting Block System: EPU41 polymer blocks that capture the plate's tabs in place of a silicone gasket strip'
